subject: Supplier account creation — onboarding preflight & PO wiring
body:
From: Elena Vazquez <elena@spruce.tech>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <vendor-ops@spruce.tech>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier onboarding packet & kickoff request

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Attached is our supplier packet — it includes the completed W-9, preferred remittance instructions, and a short vendor intake form. We'd like to get on your calendar to kick off vendor setup and confirm PO/EDI details so we can start invoice routing next month.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm who at Redwood will be the PO approver and the AP contact.
- Confirm expected PO numbering format and whether Redwood supports tacked line-item POs.
- Verify if Redwood requires a separate vendor code for each legal entity (we have two entities).
- Confirm bank-account verification steps for ACH payments (we can provide micro-deposit or bank letter).

Attachments: [Attachment: Spruce_Supplier_Packet_v1.pdf (PDF, 320 KB)] [Attachment: Spruce_W9_2026.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)]

Would you be available for a 30-minute call this week? We are Pacific time.

Thanks,
Elena Vazquez
Vendor Success Manager
Spruce HealthTech
elena@spruce.tech | (415) 555-0124

---

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elena Vazquez <elena@spruce.tech>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding packet & kickoff request

Hi Elena — welcome, and thanks for sending the packet. I'm Hannah (Vendor Ops lead). Happy to run the kickoff.

Quick answers up front:
- PO approver: For initial POs we'll route to Kate in Procurement; AP contact is marcus_lin (cc'd).
- PO format: We use RW-YYYY-##### by default; we can accept your PO numbers mapped to our system as a cross-reference.
- Legal entities: Redwood prefers a unique vendor record per legal entity. If you want to consolidate, we can record a parent/child relationship, but separate tax docs are required for each entity.
- ACH verification: We accept bank letter or micro-deposit; for faster setup we can process a bank-letter (signed) via DocuSign.

Before the call, please fill out the Vendor Intake spreadsheet (see attached template) and confirm which legal entity the PO(s) will be issued to. Also: please redact any personal SSNs if present.

Proposed times for a 30-min kickoff (PT): Thu 10/1 10:00 or Fri 10/2 11:30. Which works?

Next steps for us (what you need from Redwood):
- Finance will provision vendor record and route initial test PO (PO-0001).
- We will send a DocuSign for bank-letter if you choose that route.
- We will share our AP payment terms (Net 30 by default) and invoice remittance email.

Attachments referenced: [Attachment: Bank_Info_Template.xlsx (XLSX, 45 KB)]

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com | (650) 555-4100

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Elena Vazquez <elena@spruce.tech>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding packet & kickoff request

Adding a couple of finance notes:
- For new vendors, we run standard bank verification (micro-deposit preferred) unless a bank-letter is provided via DocuSign.
- If you prefer ACH, include ACH routing and account; we'll send a test debit/credit pair.
- Redwood requires an invoice with a PO reference; our system supports line-level matching but we recommend the vendor include PO number on header and line items to avoid rework.

Elena — if you can provide the completed Bank_Info_Template.xlsx and confirm the legal entity name exactly as it will appear on invoices, finance will kick off verification and provision a vendor ID within 48 business hours of receiving all docs.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Senior Finance Manager, AP
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Elena
